title: Kepler to Müller, 26 August 1630
author: Johannes Kepler
summary: Kepler sends the remaining years of the *Ephemerides*, to 1636, in two casks, with instructions for storing them at Frankfurt and for the entry in the fair catalogue.

notes.note: “One volume of the *Ephemerides* of Jo. Kepler (Imperial Mathematician) for twenty years, from 1617 to 1636. Completed at Sagan in Silesia, 1630.”
